My deepest praise and gratitude go to Dr. Mirha Hasanbegovic, specialist in internal medicine and cardiology, who treated my elderly mother as an emergency case during our vacation in Montenegro.
Dr. Hasanbegovic’s outstanding medical knowledge, professionalism, dedication, and genuine human touch were truly exceptional. Her ability to provide such excellent care was all the more impressive given the obvious limitations in advanced medical equipment at the medical center.
She is a true pearl, both professionally and personally, and a doctor whom any medical institution should be proud to have. I sincerely hope that the Pljevlja Medical Center recognizes, values, and takes good care of such an outstanding physician.
We are deeply grateful to her for the care, reassurance, and humanity she showed my mother at a very difficult moment.

Posebno želim istaći da, uprkos veoma lošim uslovima u kojima rade, svoj posao obavljaju predano i sa osmijehom, što zaslužuje iskreno poštovanje i zahvalnost.

Od srca im želim puno zdravlja, sreće i uspjeha u daljem radu. Hvala vam na svemu što činite za svu djecu!

Specijalna bolnica Brezovik is a well-known medical facility located in a peaceful, green area just outside Nikšić. Surrounded by nature and fresh air, it offers a calm environment that supports recovery and rest.

The staff is generally professional and dedicated, providing care and support to patients with attention and responsibility. The surroundings add to the overall positive feeling, making it a place where medical care meets a quiet and healing atmosphere.

A respected institution with a long tradition, known for its serene location and important role in healthcare in Montenegro.

Worst hospital I’ve ever gone too. And that’s saying a lot considering I’ve been stuck in hospital in multiple continents, including Africa. Nurses/doctors, especially from the second shift were extremely rude, didn’t want to answer my questions on my health status, basically just wanted to get my money and put us to the door. They didn’t even ask how I was feeling, kept telling them I hit my head really hard and didn’t want to give me a CT scan… a whole nightmare. And if that wasn’t enough, they called the police to drag us out of the hospital as I was still too weak to walk on my own, simply wanting to get a few questions answered on my medical state which they never bother to answer. Left the hospital in the same condition I came in. Worst worst experience EVER. Also had like 2-3 patients for 5-6 doctors so not like they were super busy… they found it funny and amusing that the police showed up to take us outside the hospital??? Never really checked to lower my fever has I was shivering almost the entire time I was there.. don’t go there!

Dieses Krankenhaus ist dreckig und unorganisiert. Sogar auf der Intensivstation und der Station für Herzerkrankungen war jeder Desinfektionsspender nicht nur leer, sondern ausgetrocknet. Selbst wenn man nach Desinfektionsmittel für die Hände fragt, sagen sie, dass sie nichts haben. Das sollte man eigentlich dem Gesundheitsamt melden. Und auch sonst herrscht da ein einziges Chaos. Essen steht auf einem Drucker (?), Dreck auf dem Boden und es ist einfach unhygienisch.
Wenn man in Nikšić krank werden sollte, sollte man besser auf eine Privatklinik ausweichen.  Aber Hauptsache man darf nicht mit kurzer Hose rein gehen. Lächerliche Standards werden dort gesetzt.
